claims: Assess and manage severe hyperkalemia (K 6.3 mEq/L) with ECG monitoring and potassium-lowering therapy.
Evaluate dialysis adequacy and urgent indications for hemodialysis given creatinine 15.2 mg/dL, BUN 108 mg/dL, and dialysis-dependent status.
Monitor volume status and ultrafiltration output closely to guide fluid removal.
Recheck electrolytes and renal function panel to assess response to therapy.
Evaluate and manage metabolic acidosis (bicarbonate 18 mEq/L, anion gap 34 mEq/L).
Evaluate and manage hyperphosphatemia (phosphate 8.1 mg/dL) with phosphate binders and dietary restriction.
Assess and manage hypermagnesemia (magnesium 4.2 mg/dL), avoiding magnesium-containing medications.
Monitor blood glucose and manage hyperglycemia (glucose 208 mg/dL).
Continue renal-dose adjusted medications and avoid nephrotoxins; review active medication list for renal appropriateness.
Maintain fall precautions and bed rest with assistance for mobility given Braden activity score and bed rest status.
